## Source: amazon-inspector (ab64feb6e332be8ba2d37c9d1efdc21148c1e9b0ff1f849bd35d33dee2602a4f)
Analysis of batchspar 0.1.0 surfaced no indicators of installer harm. No install-time or import-time network activity, no credential or environment scraping, no dropper or fetch-and-execute behavior, no silent-relay path, and no backdoor mechanism were observed across the scanned files.

## Source: kam193 (76a342534dec5ecb047459f9123ae99c1b91ef8e84305854529a260b8d2a3acd)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
